REAL DAYS ONLY (768 real_cached days)

# Madrugada backtest

## What this does and does not show

- Days evaluated: 768 (0 synthetic, 768 real_cached); every day with enough history for the forecast proxy, none hand-picked.
- 768 region-days on 431 distinct dates in 3 regions. Region-days on the same date (and consecutive days) are correlated, so 768 is not the effective sample size; CIs resample whole dates.
- Heat-only planning is the closest baseline; see the B3 rows.
- real_cached: the optimizer has fewer AQI>=101 hours than b3_early on 5 and than b3_late on 5 of 768 days.
- Numbers are modeled exposure-hours from station-level data. They are not health outcomes, not field microclimate, and not a compliance assessment.

Runtime 250.36 s.

Definitions:
- primary_outcome: physical dominance: win = no more hours >=95F and no more AQI>=101 hours and strictly less on at least one; loss = the reverse; tie = all physical metrics within 0.125 h; otherwise mixed
- secondary_outcome: uses the optimizer's own cost: win/loss by observed weighted cost; tie also needs cost within 1e-06; mixed = equal cost, different physical metrics
- difference: challenger minus baseline; negative = fewer modeled exposure-hours or lower cost
- robust: compared only on days where it did not fall back, and with the optimizer on those same days
- ci: synthetic: paired bootstrap over days; real: cluster bootstrap over calendar dates
- nowcast: SECONDARY, observed only: hours at NowCast AQI >= 101 / 151 (unverified NowCast); planning uses hourly values
- strata: {'heat_temp_f': 95, 'smoke_aqi': 101}
- weight_sensitivity: headline = day-level fraction of (setting, day) pairs; stratum totals secondary

## synthetic: SYNTHETIC, NOT EVIDENCE (n=0)

No days evaluated.

# Start-time sensitivity, WINDOW 2 (EXPLORATORY, POST-HOC: not preregistered)

768 real region-days on 431 dates. Paid hours 8.5, latest end, min block and min gap as in config. B_sun = a fixed 8.5 h shift starting at the setting's earliest start. The sunrise rule uses approximate, unverified NOAA equations (sunrise minus 30 min, rounded to 15 min); station coordinates: {'bakersfield': [35.4344, -119.0542, 'manifest'], 'fresno': [36.78, -119.7194, 'manifest'], 'tulare': [36.3187, -119.3929, 'manifest']}. CIs are date-cluster bootstrap (frozen seed, 10,000 resamples).

## What this shows

- At earliest start 05:30, the optimizer vs B2 has +0.022 [+0.010, +0.036] h/day at >=95F, about +1.3 min/day (clearly MORE hours); none of the 04:00 benefit (-0.379 h/day) remains.
- At earliest start sunrise, the optimizer vs B2 has +0.046 [+0.022, +0.070] h/day at >=95F, about +2.7 min/day (clearly MORE hours); none of the 04:00 benefit (-0.379 h/day) remains.
- 04:00: one block placed by the optimizer vs B2 -0.387 [-0.448, -0.329]; adding a second block (two-block vs one-block) +0.008 [+0.001, +0.018]. Two-block plans chosen on 4.0% of days.
- 05:30: one block placed by the optimizer vs B2 +0.000 [+0.000, +0.001]; adding a second block (two-block vs one-block) +0.021 [+0.009, +0.036]. Two-block plans chosen on 6.1% of days.
- sunrise: one block placed by the optimizer vs B2 +0.030 [+0.010, +0.051]; adding a second block (two-block vs one-block) +0.016 [+0.003, +0.029]. Two-block plans chosen on 7.4% of days.
- Against B_sun (a fixed shift at the same earliest start) the optimizer has +0.009 [+0.001, +0.019] at 04:00, physical W/T/L/M 4/729/11/24: the heat benefit vs B2 comes from starting at the earliest allowed time, not from splitting the shift or from the forecast.
